context.stage: WF-02 Step 1b — hard gate: validate tenant dashboard design

task.description:
WF-02 Step 1b (hard gate): Validate src/design/tenant-dashboard-ui.md against TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, TD-UI-03.

Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/tenant-dashboard-ui.md

Check:
1. Every TD-UI acceptance criterion has a design element
2. No implementation code present
3. useTenantContext, TenantHeader, TenantDashboardPage public signatures documented
4. Error state (unknown workspace) documented
5. resolveTenantSlug documented
6. Type E classification correct

Return PASS or FAIL. PASS required before FRONTEND-DEV can start.

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/tenant-dashboard-ui.md validated — all TD-UI-01 and TD-UI-02 MUST acceptance criteria covered, all public function signatures documented, Type E classification correct, lint exits 0.

issues.description: AuthProvider change section (lines ~112-130) contains a concrete try/catch function body. Type E artefacts should use pseudocode or behavioral descriptions instead of full implementation code blocks. Does not block implementation.

TD-UI-03 SHOULD acceptance criterion specifies redirect-to-login on unrecognised realm; design instead shows Unknown workspace fallback without redirect. The deviation is sensible (PLATFORM_ADMIN case) but should be explicitly annotated as an out-of-scope deviation with rationale per SHOULD-coverage convention.
